title: Rochdale AFC welcomes local groups for No Room for Racism fixture
excerpt: Young people and their families from BACP and Army of Kindness were invited to join Rochdale AFC as flag bearers for the club’s annual No Room for Racism fixture.
body:
Rochdale AFC has invited young people and their families from local organisations BACP and Army of Kindness to take part in its annual No Room for Racism fixture as flag bearers.

In a message announcing the occasion, the club encouraged supporters to give the visitors a wave when they spotted them at the game.

The club also congratulated Army of Kindness on a win at the Rochdale Diversity Awards, describing the recognition as “thoroughly deserved”. Its announcement did not specify the award category.

The fixture gives the participating young people and families a visible role in the club’s message against racism.

How can local sport help everyone feel welcome in Rochdale? Share your thoughts and recognise the groups making a difference in the comments.
editorial_source_note: Rochdale AFC statement supplied by the editor. Original post URL and timestamp were not supplied. Relative references to today and last night have not been converted into event dates. Opponent, result, full expansion of BACP and award category are not established by the supplied statement.
